[d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1] decision (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  Gate `report_against` and its tests on `gemini` or `anthropic` features
  The function is only reached from the feature-gated `gemini` and `anthropic` mappers, so builds without those features had an unused function and CI's `-D warnings` failed.

[d/g532e4d229a6c-1] decision (cited, source git:532e4d229a6c98c1cb4b98ba9709a1179deb897f)
  Add six binary tests for cmd_fmt covering listed fmt decisions.
  Twelve mutants survived in cmd_fmt because nothing reached the command through the binary. The tests drive the binary as a user would, killing mutants in those decisions and reducing survivors from 12 to 2.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-10] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Update public API snapshots to include FORMAT_VERSION_DEFAULT and the new smysl-core count.
  api-check detected the surface growth as intended; adding an export is not a breaking change, so the snapshot must be regenerated.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-12] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Update format spec §8.5 to record the version-trap defect as fixed in 0.14.
  -> causes q/g69ea5c05d859-12-1

[d/g69ea5c05d859-14] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Defer flipping the writer default to smysl/1.0 until 0.14 is published.
  §8.2 requires readers to refuse a version absent from their list. Flipping the writer before 0.14 is in the field would make every other implementation reject the output.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-15] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Do not add version lists to python/, nodejs/, go/ implementations.
  All three read CBOR only and the wire carries no version string, so no surface parser ever sees a @doc header there. The migration plan's assumption was wrong.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-16] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Do not treat this as a breaking change or require a major version bump.
  ParseOutcome and WriteContext are #[non_exhaustive], so adding fields does not break embedders, and write_surface's signature never changed. semver remains clean.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-2] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Add FORMAT_VERSION_DEFAULT, separate from FORMAT_VERSIONS_SUPPORTED[0], and export it from the facade.
  The two constants stopped meaning the same thing once the supported list grew: one governs what is emitted, the other what is accepted. Embedders need to know the default version to declare.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-5] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Add format_version to WriteContext and make write_surface emit it instead of FORMAT_VERSIONS_SUPPORTED[0].
  The writer should rebuild the header from what the parsed document carried, not from a build-time constant that relabels documents when more than one version is supported.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-6] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Pass the parsed format_version from ParseOutcome to WriteContext in `smysl fmt`.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-7] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Replace the versioning tripwire count assertion with a round-trip property test for every supported version.
  The tripwire fired as intended when the list grew. The property it was standing in for is that a document declaring either supported version comes back declaring the one it declared, which a count cannot say.

[d/g87345653cdf3-1] decision (cited, source fuzz/fuzz_targets/pack_exact.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Build Constraints via default and field assignment instead of struct literal

[d/g87345653cdf3-10] decision (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Assert on transcript count rather than just MISMATCHED presence in doc output test
  The first version asserted only that MISMATCHED appeared, which ran 0 transcripts satisfied; the count assertion ensures a gate that cannot confuse nothing wrong with nothing checked.
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-10-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-11] decision (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Compile out the doc output test outside the default-ish feature set
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-11-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-2] decision (cited, source fuzz/fuzz_targets/pack_exact.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Remove unused BTreeSet import from pack_exact.rs

[d/g87345653cdf3-4] decision (cited, source git:87345653cdf330199730f4e8a0afe2275902ad11)
  Make `make ci` depend on fuzz-build
  CI must see fuzz compilation because local checks passed while the break existed; this makes the gate structural.
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-4-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-6] decision (cited, source git:87345653cdf330199730f4e8a0afe2275902ad11)
  Do not run fuzzers as part of make ci; only compile them
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-6-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-7] decision (cited, source scripts/verify-doc-output.py@87345653cdf3)
  Make verify-doc-output.py binary path overridable via SMYSL_BIN
  This lets the new cargo test pass the binary cargo built for it, so mutation testing exercises the mutated binary rather than a stale one.

[d/g87345653cdf3-8] decision (cited, source scripts/verify-doc-output.py@87345653cdf3)
  Fix path extraction in verify-doc-output.py to skip token 0

[d/g87345653cdf3-9] decision (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Add tests/doc_output.rs so cargo test runs the doc output replay
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-9-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-3] decision (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Decline to keep the search that measured the pass.

[d/ga18e230ae345-5] decision (cited, source crates/smysl-pack/src/solve.rs@a18e230ae345)
  Add a comment explaining the removal in place of the loop.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-5-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-6] decision (cited, source CHANGELOG.md@a18e230ae345)
  Document the removal in the changelog.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-6-1

[e/g69ea5c05d859-9-1] evidence (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
